findings.source_scope: Reviewed the verified local Nonparametric classification with missing data PDF by Torben Sell, Thomas B. Berrett and Timothy I. Cannings: arXiv:2305.11672v2, 2 May 2024, 73 pages. Title, author names, version/date, submission header and source hash agree. Main text ends with funding on page 22; only the S1 heading on page 23 was inspected. Supplementary Sections S1-S5 and their later references were excluded.
findings.inventory: Independent uppercase Theorem-heading enumeration over all 22 main-text pages confirms exactly Theorem 1 on page 9 and Theorem 2 on page 12, excluding three ordinary-case references. Both complete statements fit on their recorded pages and were compared with the rendered source. Main-text proof overviews were included in enumeration; no Proposition or supplementary result was counted as a Theorem.
findings.original_statements: Theorem 1 retains every class-parameter range and constant restriction, patternwise minima/maxima, the full rate R and both conditional minimax inequalities. The upper unavailable-pattern indicator is outside the constant-times-log-rate term. Theorem 2 retains positive c_E, C_L>=1, availability of all active patterns, its exact ordinary-log sample-size exponent on U(Omega_star) intersect N, and the full uniform HAM risk bound under Q-plus-Miss. The additional lower-bound restrictions of Theorem 1 are not inserted into Theorem 2. Both outer expectations condition on the full mask sequence; both risk bounds use the distinct log-plus function.
findings.experiment_and_definitions: All 30 source entries and six auxiliary passages were checked on pages 3-12. Masks zero coordinates without changing ambient dimension. Training triples are iid with masked features and complete labels; the test pair has the unconditional marginal P_Q. The measurable classifier class, conditional test loss, Bayes tie convention and weighted excess-loss integral are preserved. Definition 1 uses all compatible subvector regressions at support points and does not impose MCAR, independence of coordinates or absence of mask mass outside the specified set O.
findings.classes_and_measures: The centered anova recursion, its reconstruction and the conditional second-moment signal match pages 5-7. Antichains and strict predecessors retain their original order; U is the complement of the active set and lower closure, including incomparable patterns. Unconditional and conditional masked measures remain separate. Lower density uses open balls, radii strictly between zero and one and pattern dimension in the denominator. Tail exponents and smoothness exponents are minima over selected coordinates. The strict margin event includes exact ties. The prime intersection class, containing-mask counts, available pattern set and log(max(x,e)) convention match pages 3 and 8.
findings.algorithm: All 21 lines of Algorithm 1 were compared with page 11: centered empirical class proportion, ascending pattern-size estimation, k-neighbor residuals, empirical signals, descending threshold selection and final reconstruction. Its numeric computation does not consume population components or signal values. The nearest-neighbor count exceeds available cases at n_omega=1, and its literal U({omega}) selection rule suppresses incomparable candidates unlike the prose. Projection/index mismatches, zero-over-zero exponents outside active coordinates, unspecified ties and traversal order remain source issues. Page 19 separately restricts k_omega to [n_omega] in proof notation without correcting the algorithm.
findings.plus_class: Definition 3+ retains the original unconditional-measure tail bound and additionally bounds the same small-density event under every compatible conditional training measure. Theorem 2 uses the intersection obtained by replacing that tail constituent, while its other population requirements remain. This stronger class and HAM are not dependencies of the all-classifier minimax result.
findings.dependency_review: All 25 direct uses, 57 related connections and 30 local prerequisite lists were reviewed. Theorem 1 reaches entries D1-D27, and Theorem 2 reaches D1-D30, with separate direct paths. Algorithm temporary values remain inside its complete source statement. Neither the oracle proof algorithm nor population signal values are introduced as numerical inputs to HAM. Related-theorem explanations identify each direct occurrence or intervening original definition.
findings.names_and_highlights: Every natural-language name and selector is supported by its own source statement, label or linked theorem. Bold coordinate vectors remain distinct from unbolded patternwise exponents; source classes and excess loss retain script typography. The D19 naming context on page 7 was checked against the printed sentence and its bold gamma vector. Source labels and all original theorem and definition bodies remain unchanged.
findings.correction: A Python non-raw string turned the backslash-b in the D19 naming-context boldsymbol command into a backspace. The saved extraction now uses a raw string for that passage. Only this one context differs in the four derived artifacts that contain it. The original six JSON files and audit are preserved in review-history/before-naming-context-escape-correction, and the current audit records updated hashes and the previous audit hash. No theorem, definition, edge, count or parameter restriction changed.
findings.limitations: All 27 source notes and three excluded-reference records are retained. Empty compatible-mask minima, empty extrema in Theorem 1, unspecified conditional versions and the algorithm ambiguities remain unresolved rather than repaired. The source describes the anova terms as orthogonal without assuming independent coordinates; that description is recorded without proof certification. No final-journal equivalence or supplementary proof review is claimed.
findings.validation: Inventory and census validators pass. All six artifacts reproduce byte for byte after the single correction. Checks cover all fresh main-text pages, actual headings, source identity and bounds, complete inventory handoff, direct/local/recursive dependencies, source types, names, selectors, mathematical delimiters and absence of control characters. Archived artifacts match their original hashes and differ from current content only by the verified naming-context repair.

evidence.scope: Supplementary S1 heading only; body excluded.
